_meta.source_note: Hand-curated from web search + Liquipedia page summarization (liquipedia.net/dota2/Version_7.41e), since this patch postdates built-in model knowledge. This is patch-notes-parsed data, NOT an official structured feed - treat as directional/inspectable, not ground truth. Only heroes confirmed to have an explicit balance change are listed here; any hero not in this file was verified (via targeted follow-up queries against common tournament picks: Puck, Windranger, Treant Protector, Slardar, Tusk, Kez, Io, Shadow Fiend, Shadow Demon, Templar Assassin, Bristleback, Ringmaster, Largo, Viper, Timbersaw, Huskar, Chen, Monkey King, Ursa, Pangolier, Phoenix, Warlock, Storm Spirit, Rubick, Winter Wyvern, Lifestealer, Underlord, Slark) or reasonably assumed to be untouched by this patch - a real, expected outcome given patch 7.41e only rebalanced ~34 of 127 heroes.
known_review_flags: Keeper of the Light: sources gave inconsistent classification (one pass called it a straight nerf, another split it into a buffed cast-range change and a nerfed cast-range/cooldown change). Kept as 'mixed' here but worth a manual patch-notes read before trusting.
_meta.usage_note: This file is CONTEXT/ANNOTATION ONLY - it is not used as a numeric score input in compute_patch_impact.py. The actual patch_impact_score is computed entirely from real observed data (OpenDota heroStats pub_win_trend/pub_pick_trend), because a hand-parsed qualitative 'buffed/nerfed' label can't be meaningfully weighted into a number. This file exists so each hero's numeric trend can be paired with a human-readable 'why' when inspecting results.

Ancient Apparition.summary: Ice Blast cooldown reduced from 60/50/40 to 50/45/40.

Axe.summary: Base agility reduced from 20 to 18; Battle Hunger damage scaling reduced across levels.

Bane.summary: Ichor stacks increased to 6 but status resistance reduction per stack lowered; Nightmare duration reduced; Scepter upgrade cooldown bonus decreased.

Batrider.summary: Smoldering Resin no longer applies when attacking allied units.

Beastmaster.summary: Level 20 talent (+30 Damage Aura) reduced to +25; Level 25 talent (-25s Primal Roar cooldown) reduced to -20s.

Centaur Warrunner.summary: Retaliate strength-based bonus damage reduced from 16/24/32/40% to 14/21/28/35%; Shard Double Edge buff duration decreased.

Chaos Knight.summary: Chaos Bolt projectile speed increased from 700 to 900.

Clockwerk.summary: Mana Shock mana burn reduced; attack push distance decreased progressively; Power Cogs no longer block neutral camps.

Doom.summary: Base attack range reduced from 200 to 175; Infernal Blade base damage increased but its health-scaling component rescaled downward.

Dragon Knight.summary: Wyrm's Wrath area-of-effect bonus increased from 25/50/75/100 to 30/60/90/120.

Drow Ranger.summary: Multishot damage factor reduced from 1/1.2/1.4/1.6 to 0.8/1/1.2/1.4; mana cost increased.

Earth Spirit.summary: Base intelligence reduced from 18 to 17; Magnetize talent bonus decreased by 5%.

Elder Titan.summary: Momentum armor-to-movement-speed conversion improved; Return/Move Astral Spirit sub-abilities no longer break invisibility.

Ember Spirit.summary: Base movement speed reduced from 300 to 295.

Grimstroke.summary: Scepter Dark Portrait illusions now use (doubled) real vision ranges.

Gyrocopter.summary: Rocket Barrage mana cost reduced from 85 to 75; Homing Missile cooldown flattened and mana cost reduced.

Hoodwink.summary: Mistwoods Wayfarer proc chance slightly reduced; Sharpshooter mana cost increased; Shard Hunter's Boomerang cooldown increased.

Invoker.summary: Ghost Walk duration reduced from 60 to 50; Shard no longer adds slow radius.

Keeper of the Light.summary: False Promise cast range increased from 700/800/900 to 800/850/900 (buff), but Solar Bind cast range reduced from 850 to 750 and Chakra Magic cooldown increased (nerf). See known_review_flags.

Legion Commander.summary: Strength-related stats rescaled slightly; base attack speed increased; Level 25 talent changed from a cooldown-refresh mechanic to a cooldown-skip mechanic.

Lone Druid.summary: Spirit Bear base armor reduced from 0 to -1.

Magnus.summary: Aghanim's Scepter Horn Toss damage increased.

Medusa.summary: Split Shot toggle functionality changed (QoL rework), not mechanically weakened.

Muerta.summary: Gunslinger toggle no longer breaks invisibility.

Night Stalker.summary: Crippling Fear radius reduced from 375 to 350.

Omniknight.summary: Purification damage-to-heal factor increased from 0.35 to 0.4.

Oracle.summary: False Promise cast range increased; Fate's Edict dispel mechanics adjusted favorably.
